evidence.reason: After edit, calls reminders.reset() and reminders.evaluate(0, 0.1, "benrk") — the minutes parameter is ignored and the calendar string "benrk" is not a recognized value, so the travel branch in reminderDelay is never exercised.
After edit, returns 0 immediately when minutes===0, before the RangeError check. Combined with the left edit passing 0, this short-circuits the normal computation path.

Test asserts evaluate(20, 0.1, "work") > 0 and evaluate(-1, 0.1, "work") throws RangeError; the left edit's hardcoded 0 argument bypasses both the positive-value and negative-throw expectations for scheduledDelay's call path.
Test asserts scheduledDelay(40) > 0; with the left edit passing 0 to evaluate and the right edit returning 0 for minutes===0, this assertion is at risk of failing.

result.userExplanation: 这两处改动叠加后，scheduledDelay 丢弃了 minutes 参数并传入无效的日历值，同时 reminderDelay 对 0 提前返回，可能使既有测试与调用约定失效，证据不足以完全确认，建议谨慎处理。
result.suggestedAction: 请修改 src/scheduling.ts 中的 scheduledDelay：恢复将 minutes 参数传给 reminders.evaluate，并使用合法的 calendar 值（如 "work"），同时确认 reminders.reset() 是否应替代 reminders.initialize()；src/reminders.ts 中 reminderDelay 的 minutes===0 提前返回可保留，但需确保不影响 RangeError 校验。
